term: perro que come huevo, si no lo come lo huele

1.consolidated_definition: Dicho. (popular) Frase con que se alude a la persona de malas mañas. En Santo Domingo: “Perro que come huevo, aunque le quemen el hocico.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: Said (popular). Phrase used to refer to a person with bad manners. In Santo Domingo: "Dog that eats eggs, even if they burn its snout."
